title: Reve de Mer Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Reve De Mer is a 4 BR / 2.5 BA / 9 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. This picturesque cottage is close to the beach, fitness and a pool, plus right across the street from a small park, creating the illusion of even more outdoor space, complete with lounge chairs and a picnic table.
description_expanded: Description102 Savannah Street2 KING BEDS, 1 QUEEN, 3 TWINS - Sleeps 9* Construction Notice - Third-party construction is occurring on an adjacent lot across from this residence and may be visible or audible during permitted hours. In Seaside, Florida, construction hours are Monday–Saturday, 8 AM–6 PM. Please contact the Homeowner’s Collection team at 1-855-411-1557 to inquire on construction details.Prime Seaside Location Steps from the Beach & Town CenterReve De Mer is a beloved Seaside, Florida family retreat offering an unbeatable location just 176 yards from Seaside’s private residential beach and only a 4-minute walk to Central Square, home to more than 35 shops, restaurants, and cafés. Perfectly positioned for walkable coastal living, this home allows guests to enjoy the best of Seaside without ever needing to get in the car. Recently renovated, Reve De Mer features all-new bathrooms throughout and a beautifully updated kitchen, blending classic Seaside charm with modern comfort.Inviting Outdoor Spaces & Welcoming First ImpressionGuests arrive to a private driveway and a charming screened front porch designed for relaxed mornings and breezy evenings. The porch is furnished with rocking chairs, a bench swing, and Adirondack seating—an ideal spot for coffee, conversation, or people-watching. Around back, a screened porch with outdoor dining for four, a gas grill, and a lush, fenced backyard create a private oasis for grilling, dining, and unwinding after a beach day.Open-Concept Living with Renovated KitchenInside, the home features a bright and open floor plan connecting the living room, dining area, and kitchen—perfect for entertaining and family gatherings. The living room offers generous seating, including a large sofa and club chairs, centered around a mounted 4K UHD flat-screen TV for movie nights. The dining area seats 6–8 guests, with additional seating for two at the breakfast bar. The renovated kitchen is outfitted with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a four-burner gas range, and a large double-door refrigerator—ideal for preparing family meals or beach-day snacks.First-Floor Primary Suite & Flexible Sleeping SpaceThe first-floor king primary bedroom provides a comfortable private retreat, complete with a mounted flat-screen TV, spacious dresser, and a newly renovated ensuite bathroom. The ensuite features a marble vanity and a glass-enclosed tub/shower combination with a luxurious rain shower head. Also on the first floor is a bonus twin bed space, perfect for kids or an extra guest, along with a renovated hall bathroom and access to one of two outdoor showers.Spacious Second Floor with Sundeck & Additional BedroomsUpstairs, the second level includes three additional bedrooms and a built-in bench nook along the stairway. The front of the home opens to a large sundeck spanning the length of the house, offering treetop views and chaise loungers for relaxing in the sun.The second bedroom features a king bed with deck access.The third bedroom offers a queen bed, also with shared sundeck access.The fourth bedroom includes two twin beds, ideal for children or teens.All upstairs bedrooms share a renovated full bathroom with a single vanity and a spacious glass-enclosed walk-in shower with rain shower features.Designed for Relaxation & Family FunReve De Mer is thoughtfully stocked with puzzles, games, books, and music, providing entertainment options beyond the beach. With two enclosed outdoor showers, a full-size washer and dryer, generous outdoor living areas, and updated interiors throughout, this home delivers comfort, convenience, and classic Seaside charm.A True Seaside Family FavoriteFrom its prime location near the beach and Central Square to its renovated interiors and inviting outdoor spaces, Reve De Mer offers everything needed for a memorable Seaside vacation. Whether you’re hosting family dinners, lounging on the sundeck, or walking just steps to the sand, this exceptional Seaside home is the perfect coastal getaway.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,921 square feet176 yards (approximately a 2-minute walk) to private beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach at Savannah Pavilion, one of the largest private residential beaches on Scenic Highway 30ATwo enclosed outdoor showers, ideal for rinsing off after a day at the beachWiFi throughout the home, plus wireless iPod connectionTwo large LCD TVs with premium cable channelsSpacious screened front porch furnished with rocking chairsSecond-floor sun deck overlooking the park and Seaside skylineScreened outdoor dining patio off the kitchen with a gas grillFull access to Seaside amenities, including three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts (court fees apply), three pickleball courts, and a fitness centerWelcome tote upon arrival with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes included for two-bedroom and larger homes; a golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners in Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002374
